pyramiding_rule: No pyramiding into falling knives; only add to positions when existing trade is in +$3.00 profit and trailing stop locks break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar ATR expansion confirmation and zero high-impact news window overlap (plus/minus 15 minutes) before order authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00, trail remainder aggressively to capture +$25.00+ terminal targets.
